They use meditation to set intentions and focus on daily goals, and want to incorporate more mindfulness into busy days (S1.U3, S1.U6). User wants to identify personal triggers and work through childhood trauma; journaling and reflection may help them explore thoughts/emotions more deeply (S1.U4).
